executionEvidence.caseSemantics: The 12 cases are named capture snapshots in one sequential runner, not 12 independently isolated test processes. A successful final log and no errors support completion of all intervening assertions.
executionEvidence.launchIdentityLimit: Lifecycle log records explicit --extension-dir. Unlike control-clones suite, lifecycle report does not store per-file content-script hashes at launch; current source/manifest/content bytes and prior full-map independent review are linked, not a new cryptographic launch snapshot.

menuScrollReview.numericBoundary: Touch Close frame 44x44, clipped visible height 43.99780701754386 meets the existing 0.01px tolerance; do not round this to exact 44 visible CSS pixels. Initial touchTargets checks dimensions only; detailed scrolling probes additionally check viewport/overflow clipping and five hit points. HeaderTop false at scrollTop 4/0 and desktop 0 is expected before sticky top binds; the conditional assertion does not require header ownership there.
menuScrollReview.inputBoundary: Timing/hint scroll is explicit page.evaluate menu.scrollTop; subsequent Home/End/ArrowUp use browser keyboard input and observed focus. Close uses mouse click at saved checked center. No physical iPhone touch or native accessibility input was run.

trackOwnershipAndLifecycle.offIdentityBoundary: Same owned-node preservation is a successful runner assertion, not a separate serialized object identity measurement in report; TextTrack mode-change events are browser-generated acknowledgements of explicit standard mode writes by the fixture, not real system-menu choices.
trackOwnershipAndLifecycle.visibilityAndCleanupBoundary: Global disable wait explicitly checks layer and owned track absence; disabled snapshot has null panel and no cues. It does not separately serialize every menu/control count, every listener, timer, or heap allocation.
trackOwnershipAndLifecycle.replacementBoundary: Replacement snapshot proves ready/new visible output after DOM replacement in this fixture, not live YouTube SPA routing or all source-reset races.

focusAndCleanup.boundary: Original stored runtime receipt reviewed; this agent did not re-query processes, profile directory, displays, or devices. Absence of observer error fields and errors[] indicate none recorded, not fault-injection coverage.
